query: WITH entities AS (SELECT created_at, id FROM skills WHERE (NOT $1 OR project_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $2) AND COALESCE(name = $3, $3 IS NULL) AND (COALESCE((created_at, id) > ($6, $5), $5 IS NULL)) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $4) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $7 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at FROM entities i JOIN skill_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.created_at asc, i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
